when: Straight after someone signs up (if email confirmation is on)
subject: Confirm your email for Root ProjX
sample_subject: Confirm your email for Root ProjX

when: After a supporter confirms their email (or straight after sign-up if there is no confirmation step)
subject: Welcome to the movement, {{first_name}}
preheader: Follow grassroots organisations and see your impact in real time.

when: When Stripe confirms a payment has succeeded (from the webhook, not the redirect)
subject: Thank you for your gift to {{campaign_name}}
sample_subject: Thank you for your gift to Out of Many Hands

when: Same as the receipt, when the donor gave without a Root ProjX account
subject: Thank you for your gift to {{campaign_name}}
sample_subject: Thank you for your gift to Out of Many Hands

when: When a campaign the supporter gave to reaches its goal
subject: You did it: {{campaign_name}} is fully funded
sample_subject: You did it: Out of Many Hands is fully funded

when: When anyone (supporter or organisation) asks to reset their password
subject: Reset your Root ProjX password

when: As soon as an organisation submits its application
subject: We’ve received your application
preheader: We’ll get back to you within 5 working days.

when: When an admin approves the application
subject: You’re in: {{org_name}} is approved
preheader: Your organisation tools are now unlocked.
sample_subject: You’re in: Humanity Ova Vanity is approved

when: When an admin declines the application
subject: An update on your Root ProjX application
preheader: Thank you for applying. Here’s our decision.
sample_subject: An update on your Root ProjX application

when: When an admin needs more information before deciding
subject: We need a little more information
preheader: One quick thing before we can finish your review.
sample_subject: We need a little more information

when: When an organisation adds someone in Settings > Team
subject: {{inviter_name}} invited you to manage {{org_name}}
sample_subject: Donisha Prendergast invited you to manage Humanity Ova Vanity

when: When a gift to one of their campaigns is confirmed (can be sent as a daily summary instead; see the prompt)
subject: New gift to {{campaign_name}}: {{gift_amount}}
sample_subject: New gift to Out of Many Hands: £10.00

when: When an organisation publishes a campaign
subject: {{campaign_name}} is live
preheader: Share it with your community to get your first gifts in.
sample_subject: Out of Many Hands is live

when: When one of their campaigns reaches its goal
subject: {{campaign_name}} reached its goal
sample_subject: Out of Many Hands reached its goal

when: When a payout is sent to the organisation’s bank account
subject: Your payout of {{payout_amount}} is on its way
sample_subject: Your payout of £450.47 is on its way

when: To the admin inbox when an organisation submits an application
subject: New application: {{org_name}} ({{country}})
